incidents.name: BCT inviter contracts unprotected transfer helpers
incidents.notes: BCT's inviter contracts expose unprotected transfer helpers (selectors 0x4e515153 and 0xf986351d) and buy(), letting the attacker shuffle BCT between attacker-created inviters, skim the pair and sell into the distorted reserves.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x88b3eb62e363d9f153beab49c5c2ef2e785a375a created 2023-12-07T09:27:07Z by 0x7c105b177bfa6ff732c503267d8021a9485d4843, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x9c66b0c68c144ffe33e7084fe8ce36ebc44ad21e; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 10.2 BNB x $241.69/BNB at the incident timestamp 1702129049 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,465.
